title: Complete the Production Tasks API
goal: Build CRUD, validation, error semantics, business rules, filtering, search, stable sorting, and pagination as one coherent API.
steps: Implement POST and define its request/response schema.
Implement collection GET with deterministic sorting.
Implement GET by id with deliberate 404 behavior.
Implement PATCH and keep patch semantics distinct from replacement.
Implement DELETE using the product’s chosen delete semantics.
Validate untrusted payloads with Zod and shape validation failures consistently.
Add one business invariant in the service layer and one database constraint where appropriate.
Add filtering/search and prove results with fixtures.
Implement offset pagination, then cursor pagination with a stable tie-breaker.
Write API contract tests for success and important failure paths.
evidence: A clean Git diff or file-tree change
Browser, HTTP, database, test, container, or CI evidence that proves the behavior
One deliberate failure, the evidence you used, and the root-cause fix
A short explanation of why the final responsibility lives in the chosen layer
completion: I can reproduce one key part without the walkthrough.
I can explain one trade-off I deliberately chose.
I can show one failure that my tests, constraints, or runbook now protects against.
